name: Website Ventures Delivery Gate
purpose: Prevent incomplete client launches and make scope changes visible before they consume untracked fulfilment time.

launchChecks.label: Client intake is complete enough to build
Included / excluded scope and revision allowance are recorded
Approved client config exists and matches the intended business
Every displayed review/certification/project claim is backed by a real source
Desktop visual and functional QA passed
~390px mobile visual and functional QA passed
Selected assets load correctly; pending assets keep safe fallback
Domain ownership is explicit and customer ownership is preserved
Production hosting is commercially appropriate; do not launch paid clients on Vercel Hobby

changeRequestRule: Anything outside the recorded included scope becomes a visible change request before implementation. Recording a request does not mean it is automatically chargeable or approved; commercial treatment remains a decision field.
